description: Two-provider Docker example with Terra main/annotation roles and two Qwen3.7-Plus workers.

protocol_override_reasons.agent: the example exercises Goal Plus hosted by Pi through explicit API providers
protocol_override_reasons.backend: the example uses the local Docker backend
protocol_override_reasons.model: the main Goal Plus session uses the validated GPT-5.6 Terra model
protocol_override_reasons.worker_model: the two Candidate Workers use the validated Qwen3.7-Plus provider path
protocol_override_reasons.evidence_annotator_model: Evidence Annotation uses the validated GPT-5.6 Terra model
protocol_override_reasons.reasoning_effort: reasoning effort is pinned explicitly for reproducibility
protocol_override_reasons.timeout: the example uses a thirty-minute campaign budget
protocol_override_reasons.attempts_per_task: one outer Goal Plus trajectory maps K=2 to two internal workers
protocol_override_reasons.cell_concurrency: the example runs one task cell
protocol_override_reasons.judge_concurrency: the local shared Judge is serialized
protocol_override_reasons.eval_interval: the example records hidden-Judge progress every five minutes
protocol_override_reasons.internet: all model-calling roles are restricted to their resolved API endpoints and the Judge
